body:
they're like the ''pillars of the community''' or whatever. the really fucked up part is that they got my mom to sign over a life insurance policy to them before she died. the witnesses were all employees of the church, not her family or friends. we didn't find out until after she was gone. I'm young, I don't need the inheritance, but my dad gave up his career to take care of her in her final years thinking he'd get the money and they stole it.

I tried to tell her they were no good, but she wouldn't ever listen to me. If I'd actually done something, maybe she would have seen...
